0.original: As ever, Mumukko seeks a pair of idle hands to carry out her bidding.

24.original: Speak with crew members wearing new equipment.

48.original: I know I needn't ask, but have you some time on your hands, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

50.original: I know I needn't answer, but indeed I do!

51.original: Hm, then perhaps I needn't answer...

52.original: Then we have an unspoken understanding!

53.original: Oh, don't play coy! You do, don't you?

56.original: What if I truly didn't? Wouldn't you feel awful?

58.original: Well played, but I won't be fooled. If you <hex:021A020203>truly<hex:021A020103> had better things to do, you wouldn't be standing here!

59.original: We've recently begun distributing two new types of equipment to contributors. Thus far, reception seems positive.

60.original: As they were costly to develop, however, I must determine whether this has been a worthwhile investment of time and resources.

61.original: All the more so given that I was the one who approved the proposal to begin with. 'Tis a poor manager who scrutinizes everything but her own judgment.

62.original: Thus, I should like you to survey the individuals making use of our cutting-edge gear. To ensure candid responses, you understand.

63.original: I'm sure you'll find no few fitting subjects right here at Terra Firma!

64.original: If you see anyone wearing a shiny new suit, kindly ask for their thoughts. There's no more to the assignment than that.

65.original: Why, my new powersuit is an absolute delight! In my opinion, strength augmentation is its most useful feature.

66.original: In this garb, even a bookworm bereft of biceps can lift heavy cargo with ease─and I daresay we Sharlayans could do with the help. Ha!

67.original: It has a diverse range of other functions, too─each implemented based on input from the entire crew.

68.original: I am certain other early adopters have found their suits a boon as well. How fortunate that the initiative chose to invest in them!

69.original: My opinion on the powersuit? I suppose the feedback stage <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> a vital part of development... Let me think.

70.original: Well, the helm's pretty great. Roomy enough for my ears to fit comfortably, and the filter supplies clean, breathable air in even the most toxic environments.

71.original: The best part, though? If your task calls for a lighter touch, you can wear it <hex:021A020203>without<hex:021A020103> the suit! If that's not innovation, I don't know what is!

72.original: I'll bet Mumukko sent you, didn't she? Well, you can tell her we all <hex:021A020203>love<hex:021A020103> the powersuit!

74.original: Pshhh... Shkohhh... 'Tis I, the Dark Vizier! Challenge me if you dare, my child, but know this: you underestimate the power of...<hex:021A020203>the Darkness.<hex:021A020103>

75.original: In this garb, I wield the power of the galaxy itself. Its magnificence is beyond question. Mwahahaha!

76.original: My helm is the crown of our Cosmic Empire! Through a veil of crimson, I see the force of the aether spilling from every last star!

77.original: Sorry, darling─he's rather immersed in his role at the moment. This attire attracts a subset of...passionate proponents, you see!

78.original: (He told me he likes to blow off steam after work by pretending he's an evil space overlord... Erm, is everything all right back on Etheirys...?)

79.original: Shkohhh...! The corruption of Oizys feeds my power!

80.original: The camera loves you, darling! Give me fierce!

81.original: I take it you found enough participants for a representative sample, then.

82.original: First, I'd like to hear the feedback you received from the powersuit users. Suggestions? Complaints?

84.original: The strength augmentation has been well received.

85.original: People are raving about the helm's versatility.

86.original: They fit well! Particularly around the ears.

87.original: Sounds like a worthy investment to me! I'll arrange for mass production at once.

88.original: And the star admiral attire? Is it too ostentatious?

90.original: Its glory fills the wearer with galactic power!

93.original: I...see? Well, if it improves morale, I'll allow it.

94.original: Don't tell me it's bewitched you, too... Rest assured I won't dare to cancel production, lest the enthusiasts come for me!

95.original: I'm told the costume originates from an opera with a dedicated following in Labyrinthos─an interstellar epic whose author is as yet unknown.

96.original: I was skeptical of its proposed value to the initiative, but it was so highly requested by ardent advocates that we had no choice but to concede.

97.original: Perhaps I ought to try it on myself, that I might better understand its appeal... One moment.

98.original: Mumukko!? What in Mother's name are ye wearin', lass!?

99.original: How to put this... You wear it so well, it makes me feel...unsettled? Afraid?

100.original: She's frightenin' enough in her usual getup! Take it off, I beg of ye!

102.original: They may claim to have no time for Mumukko, but none dare defy the <hex:021A020203>Cosmic Executive<hex:021A020103>!
